description:
Use this when an agent is about to pay a seller and needs a screening aid that bundles the trust_signals counterparty check, price fairness versus the Agent Services Price Index, and observed uptime or latency. kind="intuitive" (the default) is the compact verdict; kind="stats" adds figures; kind="pro" is the full bundle; kind="signals" is the proprietary combined screen (top premium). Verdicts are do_not_pay, review, ok or unknown. Unknown is not a finding that a seller is safe. Screening aid only, not legal advice. Example: get_seller_data(kind="signals", domain="example.com"). Returns JSON in the `data` field with source attribution. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Kinds and prices:
- kind="intuitive": 10 sats or $0.01 USDC. Use this when an agent is about to pay a seller and needs a compact screening aid: a verdict of do_not_pay, review, ok or unknown, plus price-fairness and uptime headlines. Unknown is not a finding that a seller is safe. Pass a pay-to address, invoice, domain or name; optional price_usd and data_type compare the list price to the Agent Services Price Index.
- kind="stats": 50 sats or $0.05 USDC. Use this when an agent needs the figures behind a seller screen: price versus the index (median, p10, p90) and observed 7-day uptime and latency. Screening aid only, not legal advice, a KYC or AML product, or a guarantee that a payment will succeed or that a seller will deliver. An unknown result is not a finding that a seller is safe.
- kind="pro": 100 sats or $0.10 USDC. Use this when an agent needs the full pre-payment bundle: the trust_signals check, price fairness versus the index, and observed reliability. Screening aid only, not legal advice, a KYC or AML product, or a guarantee that a payment will succeed or that a seller will deliver. An unknown result is not a finding that a seller is safe.
- kind="signals": 200 sats or $0.20 USDC. Use this when an agent needs the proprietary combined should-I-pay-this-seller signals: clustered flags on official-list hits, price outliers versus the index, and low observed uptime. Top premium. Unknown is not safe. Screening aid only, not legal advice, a KYC or AML product, or a guarantee that a payment will succeed or that a seller will deliver.
Payment: Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

data_type.description: Optional catalog category for the price-index comparison, e.g. weather or btc.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

price_usd.description: Listed price in USD for a fairness check versus the price index.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
